title: Restricted Surface-Evaporation Accepted Publication Readiness
goal: provide an accepted-only provenance-bound publication seam for the already-qualified restricted surface-evaporation result without changing physics, top-boundary mass authority or transaction semantics
design_constraints: reuse fmr_accepted_commit_receipt_t as sole postcommit publication authority
prepare only worker/job-local scalar result metadata before commit
final publication requires exact lineage, origin revision and origin interval match with a ready accepted commit receipt
publish surface-evaporation rates and route exactly as already materialized; do not integrate rates over generic [t0,t1]
do not assume transaction time is expressed in days
do not mutate canonical or kernel mass accounting
do not add surface evaporation to total_out a second time
no direct HeadCalc or legacy runtime-internal dependency
no change to F-CI42 ownership-transfer blobs unless a blocking defect is demonstrated
no new file I/O or calendar semantics
qualification_requirements: valid dry and ponded result preparation
successful real generic commit receipt permits publication
published rates and route exactly equal prepared materialized result
committed physical state not mutated by preparation/finalization
no mass-ledger mutation or inferred evaporation amount
hard_nonclaims: surface evaporation drives the production top-boundary flux
surface evaporation is end-to-end composed into MultiSWAP execution
published rates are authoritative additional water-mass terms
